name: SikaBond®-142 Instant Nails
summary: SikaBond®-142 Instant Nails is a high strength contruction adhesive that will not slump on vertical surfaces. It can be used as a one way liquid adhesive, or a two way contact adhesive, on a variety of surfaces.
metaDescription: SikaBond®-142 Instant Nails is a high strength contruction adhesive that will not slump on vertical surfaces. It can be used as a one way liquid adhesive, or a two way contact adhesive, on a variety of surfaces.
usage: SikaBond®-142 Instant Nails can be used on a variety of substrates due to its excellent adhesion.
Concrete, cement sheeting, fibreglass and masonry
packaging: 300 gr cartridge, 12 cartridges per carton 300 gr cartridge, 6 cartridges per carton 300 gr cartridge, 3 cartridges per pack

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +25°C. Always refer to packaging. Refer to the current Safety Data Sheet for information on safe handling and storage.

items.label: Curing time
items.text: Full cure in approximately 7 days, depending on weather conditions.

items.label: Yield
items.text: ~15 linear metres for a continuous 5mm bead

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text: The substrate must be sound, clean, dry and free of all contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, cement laitance, old sealants and poorly bonded coatings which could affect adhesion, light abrasion is recommended for improved adhesion.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and equipment immediately after use with Sika® Colma Cleaner or mineral turpentine. Cured material can only be removed mechanically.
